description: A terminal browser for the Markdown Web inspired by Dave Winer's BonBon: it fetches pages as Markdown, strips HTML, follows links and a site's table of contents, and lets the reader choose how the text looks.
name: cmarkbrowser
softwareSuggestions: jq, zip and the GitHub CLI (gh), to cut a release
releaseNotes:
v0.0.1 is a working a proof of concept. 

Upgraded Go version to v1.27, updated module organization and Goldmark dpendencies.
